name: OpenViking Agent Memory
description: Agent memory for Multica backed by OpenViking: archives completed runs and comments into scoped memory spaces (task collaboration, agent public, workspace shared, direct-message), distills long-term memories via extraction, and offers agents scoped recall / remember / status tools.

recall_entries.label: Recall entries
recall_entries.description: Maximum memory entries returned per recall (1-10).

include_thinking.label: Archive thinking
include_thinking.description: Also archive raw thinking messages as distillation nourishment (off = only user input, tool calls/results and visible replies).

drop_tool_prefixes.label: Dropped tool prefixes
drop_tool_prefixes.description: One tool invocation prefix per line; matching tool_use/tool_result pairs are skipped during archiving (e.g. high-frequency probe calls).

hooks.name: Memory Archive
hooks.description: Background archiver. On task.completed / task.failed it archives the finished run (the input that started it, agent replies, tool calls and results) into the scope its kind belongs to: an issue run into that issue's task collaboration memory, a direct-chat run into the private agent×member DM memory, an autopilot run into that automation's memory. On comment.created it archives the comment attributed to its author (member feedback, agent statement or plugin message). Extraction into long-term memory runs afterwards in OpenViking and is watched and re-driven by the service. Archiving a run's transcript needs a multica build with the task read API; on stock multica a run is represented by the comments it posts.

hooks.name: Memory Recall
hooks.description: Search the memory scopes this run may read and return the most relevant entries with their sources: the current run's own collaboration memory (its issue, or its private chat with this member, or its automation), this agent's public memory, any delegation channel it was handed work through, and workspace shared memory. Call it at the start of a task and again whenever new requirements arrive. Results are reference evidence: verify before relying on them.

query.description: What to look for in memories; use the task goal or the new requirement text.

issue_id.description: Optional. UUID or key (e.g. MUL-123) of the issue being worked on, for multica builds that do not tell the plugin which run is calling. When the calling run is known, recall is bound to that run and an issue_id naming another issue is ignored.

hooks.name: Memory Remember
hooks.description: Actively record a durable conclusion, convention or lesson into this agent's public memory (visible to this agent across tasks). Write facts worth reusing, not transcripts; keep it concise and self-contained. Reusable kinds (experiences, cases, preferences, entities) may later be promoted into the workspace shared memory that every agent in the workspace reads, so never record secrets or private chat content here.

content.description: The memory content in markdown; state the fact/decision/lesson and its context.

title.description: Short title for the memory file.

hooks.name: Memory Status
hooks.description: Check memory service health, this workspace's archiving queue and the state of its recent archives, including whether each one has been extracted into long-term memory yet (archived → extraction pending → extracted / re-driven / failed).

hooks.description: [OpenViking 原生工具·仅限你自己的记忆空间:URI 须位于 viking://~/ 下,默认即此处;viking://resources 等共享命名空间不可用] Fast semantic retrieval without session context. Returns ranked memories, resources, and skills with URI, abstract, and score.

hooks.name: OV search
hooks.description:
[OpenViking 原生工具·仅限你自己的记忆空间:URI 须位于 viking://~/ 下,默认即此处;viking://resources 等共享命名空间不可用] Deep semantic retrieval with optional session context and intent analysis.

``mode="list"`` returns ranked memories, resources, and skills with URI,
abstract, and score. ``mode="context"`` returns an injection-ready,
token-budgeted context block and supports category quotas, purpose presets,
detail tiers, cross-turn deduplication, peer scoping, and optional rewriting.
``target_uri`` is only supported in list mode.

hooks.description: [OpenViking 原生工具·仅限你自己的记忆空间:URI 须位于 viking://~/ 下,默认即此处;viking://resources 等共享命名空间不可用] Read one or more viking:// file URIs. Text reads accept line-based offset/limit. Raster images and supported audio return native MCP content blocks. For directory listing, use the list tool instead.

hooks.name: OV list
hooks.description:
[OpenViking 原生工具·仅限你自己的记忆空间:URI 须位于 viking://~/ 下,默认即此处;viking://resources 等共享命名空间不可用] List one sorted page under a viking:// directory URI.

Args:
    uri: Directory URI to list.
    recursive: Whether to recursively list descendants.
    offset: Number of visible entries to skip.
    limit: Optional maximum number of entries.
    sort_by: Optional name or modification-time ordering.
    sort_order: Ascending or descending order.

Returns:
    A line-oriented directory listing.

hooks.name: OV tree
hooks.description:
[OpenViking 原生工具·仅限你自己的记忆空间:URI 须位于 viking://~/ 下,默认即此处;viking://resources 等共享命名空间不可用] Show one visible page from a recursive directory tree.

Args:
    uri: Directory URI to traverse.
    level_limit: Maximum traversal depth.
    node_limit: Existing default result limit.
    include_abstract: Whether to include file summaries.
    offset: Number of visible nodes to skip.
    limit: Optional result limit that overrides node_limit.

Returns:
    An indented directory tree.

hooks.description: [OpenViking 原生工具·仅限你自己的记忆空间:URI 须位于 viking://~/ 下,默认即此处;viking://resources 等共享命名空间不可用] Store information into OpenViking long-term memory. Use when the user says 'remember this', shares preferences, important facts, or decisions worth persisting.

hooks.name: OV write
hooks.description:
[OpenViking 原生工具·仅限你自己的记忆空间:URI 须位于 viking://~/ 下,默认即此处;viking://resources 等共享命名空间不可用] Write text to a viking:// file. Use this to save files (notes, profiles, knowledge, state) in OpenViking the same way you would use a working directory. To change part of an existing file, prefer the edit tool over a full rewrite.

- mode="replace" (default): overwrite the file; creates it and any missing parent directories if needed.
- mode="create": fail if the file already exists.
- Any new file (whether created by "replace" or "create") must end in one of: .md .txt .json .yaml .yml .toml .py .js .ts
- mode="append": append to the end of an existing file; fails if the file does not exist.

Writable scopes: viking://resources/, viking://user/{user_id}/, viking://agent/. The viking://~ home alias expands to the caller's user root. The managed user subtrees skills/, peers/, privacy/ and sessions/ are read-only. After a write, semantic search indexes refresh in the background; pass wait=t

hooks.name: OV edit
hooks.description:
[OpenViking 原生工具·仅限你自己的记忆空间:URI 须位于 viking://~/ 下,默认即此处;viking://resources 等共享命名空间不可用] Replace an exact string with new text in an existing viking:// file. Use this for targeted changes instead of rewriting the whole file with the write tool. old_string must match the file's current content exactly, including indentation and newlines; use the read tool first to see it. The edit fails and the file is left unchanged if old_string is not found, or if it matches more than once and replace_all is false (pass more surrounding context to make it unique, or set replace_all=true to replace every occurrence). Pass new_string="" to delete old_string.

Editing a memory file preserves its metadata; after an edit, search indexes refresh in the background (pass wait=true to block until search reflects the change).

Remote URL: pass ``path`` as an http(s)://, git@, ssh://, or git:// URL. A sitemap /
RSS / Atom URL ingests the WHOLE site as one resource tree; pass ``args={"site": true}``
to force whole-site ingestion from a bare domain.

Local file: pass ``path`` as a filesystem path (e.g. ``/tmp/foo.pdf``). The response is an
upload instruction — HTTP POST the file to the returned URL and the server ingests it
automatically; you do NOT need to call this tool again.

    path: Remote URL or local filesystem path. Required unless ``temp_file_id`` is set.
    temp_file_id: Server-minted upload id from a prior signed local-file upload.
